name: Probe (Terpometer V1)
description: Contact probe touches interior surface. Reads SURFACE TRUTH directly.
calibration_note: No offset applied — your reading IS the surface temp.

name: IR Thermometer (Dab Rite Pro, Octave, Terpometer Gen 2)
description: Non-contact IR. Aim per banger geometry — bucket vs slurper-class read differently.
calibration_note: Apply banger.ir_offset_sign * banger.ir_offset_f. Bucket-class subtracts (display lower than interior). Slurper-class adds (display higher than interior — thinner wall, direct flame contact). Cooldown-trigger workflow: dab on descent through target, NOT at peak torch.

name: E-Nail PID Setpoint
description: Coil temp controller. Set & forget. Coil reads 30-80°F higher than surface (varies by brand).
calibration_note: Add ~50°F midpoint to surface target. MiniNail-on-MiniNail is factory-calibrated to display surface temp directly — set PID to surface target, not the +50°F estimate.

name: No Thermometer (Visual / Timing)
description: Glow + count method. Approximate. App estimates based on form factor.
calibration_note: Use IR-equivalent values as approximate guidance. Visual cue (banger.visual_cue) is the primary signal.
